services.name: Marigny Opera Ballet
services.desc: Join us for our 13th Season as we partner with Verismo Opera to present 4 ballet-operas spanning 300 years of masterpieces in dance, singing and live orchestral music. The season will open with Alessandro Scarlatti’s rarely-performed baroque gem - Cain, overo il primo omicidio. Come see the Marigny Opera House transformed into the lavish Garden of Eden. Cain, overo il primo omicidio was originally composed as an oratorio in Rome, and will find new life as a fully staged opera-ballet. Composed during the time of tremendous political upheaval in Europe, this ballet-chanté was the last work by the genius Kurt Weill before immigrating to the United States.
